title: Fix reveal background/audio issues and update teddy visuals (transparent hugging bears + heart-holding hero)

requirements.text: Fix Phase 2 (Reveal) background image rendering so the user-uploaded background is clearly visible after the button click, using the existing asset path for the uploaded image (photo4.jpg).

quotes: Why the song is not playing and also I can't see the background image
Background Change: The background should change to a custom uploaded image i uploaded.

acceptanceCriteria: After clicking the Phase 1 button, the Reveal view displays the background image (photo4.jpg) behind the overlay and content on both mobile and desktop.
The background image request returns HTTP 200 in the browser network panel and is not blocked by an incorrect path.
The background image is not visually obscured by overlays; the overlay (if present) still allows the background to be recognizable.

requirements.text: Fix Phase 2 (Reveal) audio playback so the user-uploaded romantic song reliably loads and starts playing immediately after the button click, and provide a clear manual play fallback if autoplay is blocked.

quotes: Why the song is not playing
Audio: Start playing a background romantic song which I uploaded

acceptanceCriteria: On button click, the app attempts to play the audio and sets the UI state to reflect playback when successful.
If autoplay is blocked, a visible play control appears and successfully starts playback on user interaction.
The audio file request returns HTTP 200 in the browser network panel (no 404/failed load due to filename/path issues).
Audio continues looping as intended, and the existing mute/play toggle continues to work after playback starts.

requirements.text: Update Phase 2 visuals to use a transparent (alpha) hugging-bears asset and ensure both the hugging-bears visual and the glassmorphism message card remain semi-transparent yet clearly readable over the background (i.e., transparent but still easy to see).

quotes: New Visuals: Display a cute transparent animation or transparent image of a male and female bear hugging each other.
But the animation and message should be transparent but seen and I want the image toh be shown properly.

acceptanceCriteria: The hugging-bears visual uses a transparent image format (PNG/WebP with alpha) so the background is visible around/through it.
The hugging-bears image is displayed with correct sizing and is not stretched or cropped unexpectedly on common mobile widths.
The message card remains glassmorphism-style (semi-transparent with blur) and the text remains clearly readable against the background image.
No user-provided message text characters/emojis/punctuation are modified.

requirements.text: Update the Phase 1 hero teddy illustration to depict a single teddy bear holding a heart in its hands with the words "i love you" written on the heart, and ensure it displays crisply and centered as the hero image.

quotes: Hero Image: A cute, high-quality illustration of a single teddy bear holding i love you written heart in hands.

acceptanceCriteria: Phase 1 continues to show the heading text exactly "Happy Hug Day My Love" and the button text exactly "Hug me! Pop me! 🧸".
The hero image depicts a single teddy bear holding a heart with "i love you" written on it.
The hero image renders at the existing hero placement without distortion and remains mobile-friendly.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn components); only compose and style them from app/components.
Do not modify immutable hook files (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
Keep the app frontend-only for this experience; do not add backend dependencies or require login.
Preserve the Phase 2 message text exactly as provided (no character changes).
nonGoals: Adding new backend canister methods or persistence.
Adding third-party auth providers beyond Internet Identity.
Adding real-time features (WebSockets/chat) or external media hosting.

edits: Make the teddy bear hold a heart with the words "i love you" written on it (teddy-hero.dim_1400x900.png > teddy-hero-heart-ily.dim_1400x900.png)
Create a transparent (alpha) version of the hugging bears illustration suitable for overlay on a photo background (hugging-bears.dim_1400x900.png > hugging-bears-transparent.dim_1400x900.png)
